A '''mystical centerpiece''' was a decorative item used in religious ceremonies by the residents of [[Kerritamba Village]] in the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. It was the third and final piece of the "[[Great Tree (Kashyyyk)|Nyenthi'Oris]] Gifts" collection along with a [[ceremonial chair]] and a [[ceremonial table]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''
